description:
OFOQ | أُفُق

We are a team driven by curiosity, creativity, and a shared passion for technology, innovation, and space exploration.

Our goal for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 is to create OFOQ, an immersive and interactive space mission design game that puts players in the role of mission engineers. Players will design spacecraft, manage resources, make critical decisions, and face unexpected challenges throughout their missions.
